facts.fact: The #KeepItOn coalition says mobile service and internet access in Annobon have been restricted since 20 July 2024, after the government's security forces responded to protests there with arrests.

The #KeepItOn coalition says 16 people who signed a letter to the government asking it to stop dynamite use were detained, and security forces held at least 33 people in connection with the Annobon protests.

GNQ.note: Says nothing on local digital policy research.

facts.fact: The #KeepItOn coalition says Equatorial Guinea's government banned the sale and use of unauthorised satellite internet services and equipment on 2 August 2024 and on 5 August ordered Starlink to suspend all services and apply for a licence.
